assetNotes.cg_birth_registry: Mother is an adult brunette and newborn is the protagonist. Mina must NOT be shown as the mother.
assetNotes.cg_mina_royal_hall: Mina is silver-haired with blue eyes; never replace with red-haired knight Leon. Show only if bring_mina was selected.
assetNotes.cg_public_hearing: Portrait-leaning crop excludes the dialogue balloon baked into the original; game dialogue renders separately.
assetNotes.all: Static illustrated CG, WebP, aspect-ratio:contain, no upscaling, no compulsory image for annual one-line records.
